source.title: ASHRAE Handbook—Fundamentals, 2025, Chapter 1, Adiabatic Mixing of Two Moist Airstreams, Example 4
source.reference_values: Outdoor stream 2 m3/s at 4°C DB and 2°C thermodynamic WB; return stream 6.25 m3/s at 25°C DB and 50% RH. ASHRAE chart gives specific volumes 0.789 and 0.858 m3/kg dry air, and mixed dry-bulb 19.5°C / thermodynamic wet-bulb 14.6°C.
source.method: Convert each volumetric flow at its own state to dry-air mass flow using v = 0.287055 (T + 273.15) (1 + 1.607 W) / p; mass-weight humidity ratio and enthalpy; recover dry-bulb from h = 1.006 t + W (2501 + 1.86 t).
assumptions: Constant pressure 101.325 kPa and adiabatic mixing.

The fixed humidity ratios and enthalpies below are chart-consistent independent inputs rounded to the precision shown; the dry-bulb result is compared to a separate hand-calculation from those constants.
The source chart reports mixed-state values graphically, so its 19.5°C result is a plausibility check rather than an implementation tolerance.
exclusions: Duct heat gain, fan heat, leakage beyond the represented outdoor stream, and condensate are excluded.
The coil test uses a stated inlet volume-flow basis and does not resolve the AHU artifact model's missing airflow-reference field.

reference_reported_values.source: ASHRAE Fundamentals F25 Chapter 1 Example 3; chart values rounded as published; h_water from Table 3

source_citation.title: ASHRAE Handbook—Fundamentals, 2025, Chapter 1, Moist Air Cooling and Dehumidification, Example 3 and Table 3
source_citation.reported_values: 30°C DB / 50% RH inlet; 5 m3/s; saturated 10°C leaving state; chart enthalpy, humidity ratio, and specific-volume values; liquid-water enthalpy at 10°C is 42.021 kJ/kg (Table 3).

cases.equation: m_da = volume_flow / v_inlet; m_cond = m_da × (W_inlet − W_leaving); Q_total = m_da × (h_inlet − h_leaving) − m_cond × h_liquid; Q_sensible = m_da × 1.006 × (T_inlet − T_leaving); Q_latent = Q_total − Q_sensible.
assumptions: Steady state; no fan/duct heat or condensate subcooling; outlet liquid condensate is at the leaving-air temperature.
The example inlet flow is explicitly referenced to the entering-air state.
ASHRAE chart inputs are rounded as published; expected outputs are fixed calculations from those inputs.

ASHRAE Example 3 publishes the total refrigeration requirement, not a sensible/latent split; the fixture's split uses the project's explicit dry-air-only cp convention and is not independently validated.
exclusions: Does not resolve the AHU model airflow-reference condition for project supply-air L/s.
Does not validate coil bypass factor, wet-surface behavior, frost, or condensate subcooling.
